page.content:
Original brick theme park beside the Billund factory.

How Legoland Billund connects

  • Location: Billund — Legoland Billund stands in the same town as the factory.
  • Topic: LEGO — Legoland Billund is the original park built from the brick system.

What is Legoland Billund?

Legoland Billund opened in 1968 as a park of miniland cities and rides built from the same System of Play sold in boxes, turning the factory town into a destination.

Key threads lead to Billund and LEGO.
